decisions.reason: Identifies the running dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as holding koffi.node and explains the native binary remains locked until that host exits, causing EBUSY.
Explains browser refresh does not stop the host and gives the stop/verify, install, restart sequence without calling for unrelated Node processes to be killed.
Explains bare npm global install follows latest, which resolves to 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, causing a downgrade from alpha.4.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 with @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui, then dsh --version verification and host restart.
Tells README authors to pin exact tested core versions and avoid bare latest-following combined install commands that can silently downgrade prerelease users.
